seoTitle: How to Use Looker Studio with Google Sheets
metaDescription: Connect Google Sheets to Looker Studio to build interactive dashboards with scorecards, bar charts, and timeline graphs, no coding needed.
intro: Turning static spreadsheet rows into a live, shareable dashboard is possible without writing any code, using Google Looker Studio's native Sheets connector. This guide covers structuring your data, linking your spreadsheet, and adding visual charts to your report canvas.

steps.heading: Organize your spreadsheet data
steps.body: Structure your Google Sheets columns and headers cleanly so Looker Studio can map them correctly.

steps.heading: Create a new report
steps.body: Open the Looker Studio home panel and start a new report instance.

steps.heading: Select the Google Sheets connector
steps.body: Choose the native Google Sheets data connector to link your spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Authorize account access
steps.body: Grant the necessary Drive permissions so Looker Studio can read your spreadsheet file.

steps.heading: Choose your file and worksheet
steps.body: Pick the specific spreadsheet file and worksheet tab you want to visualize.

steps.heading: Add charts and scorecards
steps.body: Review the detected dimensions and metrics, then add scorecards, bar charts, and timeline graphs to your canvas layout.

faq.question: Do I need to write any code to build the dashboard?
faq.answer: No, connecting Google Sheets to Looker Studio and adding charts is a no-code, drag-and-drop process.

faq.question: Will my dashboard update automatically as the spreadsheet changes?
faq.answer: Yes, since the report is connected directly to your Google Sheets file, it can reflect updated data as your source spreadsheet changes.

faq.question: What kind of charts can I add?
faq.answer: Looker Studio supports several visual types, including scorecards, bar charts, and timeline graphs, among others.

faq.question: Can I share the finished dashboard with others?
faq.answer: Yes, Looker Studio reports can be shared as a live, viewable link similar to sharing a Google Doc or Sheet.
